name: Home of The Ancients - Future - ZIT
description: Finding all my models or profile elsewhere than Civitai is without my consent ! Please don't repost my files. Send people to my Civitai profile, thanks :) - "Home of The Ancients" is a new serie to thank all my followers. It's a Special Edition serie. -- FUTURE : Background / Character Creator This is a background / Style / Character creator. Get nice pics with only a few words ;) This lora can do ANIME and REALISTIC. However, because of ZIT and many real pics in the dataset, you may get realistic pics even if you prompt for Anime. But if you insist, you'll get anime... uh well maybe :P The dataset is big and is a mix of anime and realistic pics. I used some pics of my Ronin dataset for the Japan part. The training time was very long, due to the large dataset. Some pics of SW Poetic V5 were also used to make spaceship designs. You can create whatever you want. BUT since I first wanted to make something about Japan (because I've played FH6 for the past few days I guess)... you may get many pics Japan oriented unless you prompt otherwise. For FUN AND TESTING only :) -- HOW TO USE : Strength : 1 tested Steps : 15 tested Checkpoints : Any but I use the Base BF16 model. Adetailer : not used, your choice Sampler : Tested with EULER Scheduler : NORMAL -- The main trigger word are : To get anime : z1os, japanese animation, ultra detailed, soft anime aesthetics To get realistic : z1os, ultra detailed, -- see pictures for prompt exemples :) -- Have fun ^^
